FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine-nginx:3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG NEXTCLOUD_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="aptalca"

# environment settings
ENV LD_PRELOAD="/usr/lib/preloadable_libiconv.so"

RUN \
  echo "**** install runtime packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    ffmpeg \
    gnu-libiconv \
    imagemagick \
    libxml2 \
    php85-apcu \
    php85-bcmath \
    php85-bz2 \
    php85-dom \
    php85-exif \
    php85-ftp \
    php85-gd \
    php85-gmp \
    php85-imap \
    php85-intl \
    php85-ldap \
    php85-pcntl \
    php85-pdo_mysql \
    php85-pdo_pgsql \
    php85-pdo_sqlite \
    php85-pecl-imagick \
    php85-pecl-memcached \
    php85-pecl-smbclient \
    php85-pgsql \
    php85-posix \
    php85-redis \
    php85-sodium \
    php85-sqlite3 \
    php85-sysvsem \
    php85-xmlreader \
    rsync \
    samba-client \
    sudo && \
  echo "**** configure php-fpm to pass env vars ****" && \
  sed -E -i 's/^;?clear_env ?=.*$/clear_env = no/g' /etc/php85/php-fpm.d/www.conf && \
  if ! grep -qxF 'clear_env = no' /etc/php85/php-fpm.d/www.conf; then echo 'clear_env = no' >> /etc/php85/php-fpm.d/www.conf; fi && \
  echo "env[PATH] = /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" >> /etc/php85/php-fpm.conf && \
  echo "**** configure php for nextcloud ****" && \
  { \
    echo 'apc.enable_cli=1'; \
  } >> /etc/php85/conf.d/apcu.ini && \
  { \
    echo 'opcache.enable=1'; \
    echo 'opcache.interned_strings_buffer=32'; \
    echo 'opcache.max_accelerated_files=10000'; \
    echo 'opcache.memory_consumption=128'; \
    echo 'opcache.save_comments=1'; \
    echo 'opcache.revalidate_freq=60'; \
    echo 'opcache.jit=1255'; \
    echo 'opcache.jit_buffer_size=8M'; \
  } >> "/etc/php85/conf.d/00_opcache.ini" && \
  { \
    echo 'memory_limit=-1'; \
    echo 'upload_max_filesize=100G'; \
    echo 'post_max_size=100G'; \
    echo 'max_input_time=3600'; \
    echo 'max_execution_time=3600'; \
    echo 'output_buffering=0'; \
    echo 'always_populate_raw_post_data=-1'; \
  } >> "/etc/php85/conf.d/nextcloud.ini" && \
  echo "**** install nextcloud ****" && \
  mkdir -p \
    /app/www/src/ && \
  if [ -z ${NEXTCLOUD_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    NEXTCLOUD_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET https://api.github.com/repos/nextcloud/server/releases \
      | jq -r '.[] | select(.prerelease == true) | .tag_name' \
      | sed 's|^v||g' | sort -rV | head -1); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/nextcloud.tar.bz2 -L \
    https://download.nextcloud.com/server/prereleases/nextcloud-${NEXTCLOUD_RELEASE}.tar.bz2 && \
  tar xf /tmp/nextcloud.tar.bz2 -C \
    /app/www/src --strip-components=1 && \
  rm -rf /app/www/src/updater && \
  mkdir -p /app/www/src/data && \
  chmod +x /app/www/src/occ && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/*

# copy local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 80 443
VOLUME /config

units.name: init-nextcloud-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# create folders
mkdir -p \
    /app/www/public \
    /config/www/nextcloud/apps \
    /config/www/nextcloud/config \
    /config/www/nextcloud/themes \
    /data

# migrate legacy install (copy inside container)
if [[ -f /config/www/nextcloud/version.php ]]; then
    echo "Migrating legacy install (this can take a while) ...)"
    rsync -rlD --remove-source-files --exclude-from=/app/upgrade.exclude /config/www/nextcloud/ /app/www/public/
    rm -rf /config/www/nextcloud/updater/
    find \
        /config/www/nextcloud/ \
        -type d -empty \
        ! -path "/config/www/nextcloud/apps" \
        ! -path "/config/www/nextcloud/config" \
        ! -path "/config/www/nextcloud/themes" \
        -delete
    touch /config/www/nextcloud/config/needs_migration
fi

# symlink config folders
for dir in apps config themes; do
    if [[ "$(readlink /app/www/public/${dir})" != "/config/www/nextcloud/${dir}" ]]; then
        rm -rf "/app/www/public/${dir}"
        ln -s "/config/www/nextcloud/${dir}" "/app/www/public/${dir}"
        lsiown abc:abc "/config/www/nextcloud/${dir}" "/app/www/public/${dir}"
    fi
done

# get versions
image_version=$(php -r "require '/app/www/src/version.php'; echo implode('.', \$OC_Version);" 2>/dev/null | xargs)
installed_version=$(php -r "require '/config/www/nextcloud/config/config.php'; echo \$CONFIG['version'];" 2>/dev/null | xargs)
if [[ "${installed_version}" = "" ]]; then
    installed_version="0.0.0.0"
fi
image_major="${image_version%%.*}"
installed_major="${installed_version%%.*}"
((max_upgrade = installed_major + 1))

# compare versions
vergte() { printf '%s\n%s' "${2}" "${1}" | sort -C -V; }
vergt() { ! vergte "${2}" "${1}"; }
verlte() { printf '%s\n%s' "${1}" "${2}" | sort -C -V; }
verlt() { ! verlte "${2}" "${1}"; }

if vergt "${installed_version}" "${image_version}"; then
    echo "Can't start Nextcloud because the version of the data (${installed_version}) is higher than the docker image version (${image_version}) and downgrading is not supported. Are you sure you have pulled the newest image version?"
    sleep infinity
fi

if [[ "${installed_version}" != "0.0.0.0" ]] && vergt "${image_major}" "${max_upgrade}"; then
    echo "Can't start Nextcloud because the version of the data (${installed_version}) is more than one major version behind the docker image version (${image_version}) and upgrading more than one major version is not supported. Please run an image tagged for the major version ${max_upgrade} first."
    sleep infinity
fi

if [[ "${installed_version}" = "0.0.0.0" ]] || [[ ! -f /app/www/public/version.php ]] || [[ -z "$(ls -A /config/www/nextcloud/apps 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
    touch /tmp/needs_install
fi

if [[ "${installed_version}" != "0.0.0.0" ]] && vergt "${image_version}" "${installed_version}"; then
    touch /tmp/needs_upgrade
fi

# initialize nextcloud
if [[ -f /config/www/nextcloud/config/needs_migration ]] || [[ -f /tmp/needs_install ]] || [[ -f /tmp/needs_upgrade ]]; then
    echo "Initializing nextcloud ${image_version} (this can take a while) ..."
    if [[ -f /config/www/nextcloud/config/needs_migration ]] || [[ -f /tmp/needs_upgrade ]]; then
        echo "Upgrading nextcloud from ${installed_version} ..."
        shippedApps=$(jq -r .shippedApps[] /app/www/src/core/shipped.json)
        for app in ${shippedApps}; do
            rm -rf "/config/www/nextcloud/apps/${app}"
        done
    fi

    rsync -rlD --exclude-from=/app/upgrade.exclude /app/www/src/ /app/www/public/
    for dir in apps config themes; do
        if [[ -f /config/www/nextcloud/config/needs_migration ]] || [[ -f /tmp/needs_upgrade ]] || [[ -z "$(ls -A /app/www/public/${dir} 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
            rsync -rlD --include "/${dir}" --exclude '/*' /app/www/src/ /config/www/nextcloud/
        fi
    done
    if [[ -z "$(ls -A /data/ 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
        rsync -rlD --include "/data" --exclude '/*' /app/www/src/ /
    fi

    echo "Setting permissions"
    lsiown abc:abc /data
    lsiown -R abc:abc \
        /app/www/public \
        /config/www/nextcloud

    if [[ -f /config/www/nextcloud/config/needs_migration ]] || [[ -f /tmp/needs_upgrade ]]; then
        # Upgrade
        occ upgrade
    else
        if [[ "${installed_version}" = "0.0.0.0" ]]; then
            # Install
            echo "New nextcloud instance"
            echo "Please run the web-based installer on first connect!"
        fi
    fi

    echo "Initializing finished"
fi

rm -f \
    /config/www/nextcloud/config/needs_migration \
    /tmp/needs_install \
    /tmp/needs_upgrade

# permissions
lsiown abc:abc \
    /app/www/public \
    /config/www/nextcloud

# setup config
if occ config:system:get installed >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if ! occ config:system:get memcache.local >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        occ config:system:set memcache.local --value='\\OC\\Memcache\\APCu'
    fi
    if ! occ config:system:get filelocking.enabled >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        occ config:system:set filelocking.enabled --value=true --type=boolean
    fi
    if ! occ config:system:get memcache.locking >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        occ config:system:set memcache.locking --value='\\OC\\Memcache\\APCu'
    fi
    if ! occ config:system:get datadirectory >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        occ config:system:set datadirectory --value='/data'
    fi
    if ! occ config:system:get upgrade.disable-web >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        occ config:system:set upgrade.disable-web --value=true --type=boolean
    fi
else
    echo "After completing the web-based installer, restart the Nextcloud container to apply default memory caching and transactional file locking configurations."
    echo "Alternatively, you can apply your own configurations by editing /config/www/nextcloud/config/config.php following the documentation:"
    echo "https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/latest/admin_manual/configuration_server/caching_configuration.html"
    echo "https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/latest/admin_manual/configuration_files/files_locking_transactional.html"
fi

# remove problematic apps
for APP in richdocumentscode; do
    if (occ app:list | grep -q " - ${APP}:") 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "Removing ${APP}"
    fi
    APP_PATH=$(occ app:getpath "${APP}" 2>/dev/null)
    if [[ -z "${APP_PATH}" ]] || [[ ! -d "${APP_PATH}" ]]; then
        APP_PATH="/app/www/public/apps/${APP}"
    fi
    if [[ -d "${APP_PATH}" ]]; then
        occ app:disable "${APP}" >/dev/null 2>&1
    fi
    APP_STATUS="$(occ config:app:get "${APP}" enabled 2>/dev/null)"
    if [[ "${APP_STATUS}" != "no" ]] && [[ -n "${APP_STATUS}" ]]; then
        occ config:app:set "${APP}" enabled --value="no" >/dev/null 2>&1
    fi
    occ app:remove "${APP}" >/dev/null 2>&1
    rm -rf "${APP_PATH}"
done

# set data directory
if [[ ! -s /config/www/nextcloud/config/config.php ]]; then
    echo -e "<?php\n\$CONFIG = array (\n    'datadirectory' => '/data',\n);" >/config/www/nextcloud/config/config.php
elif [[ -f /config/www/nextcloud/config/config.php ]]; then
    sed -i "s|/app/www/public/data|/data|g" /config/www/nextcloud/config/config.php
fi

#modify javascript mime type and add .mjs support
if [[ -s /etc/nginx/mime.types ]]; then
    sed -i 's|\bjs;|js mjs;|g' /etc/nginx/mime.types
    sed -i 's|\bapplication/javascript|text/javascript|g' /etc/nginx/mime.types
fi

notes.upstream:
## Nextcloud 35.0.3rc1

### [server](https://github.com/nextcloud/server)
* [Fix\(sharing\): hide external sharing section when link sharing disabled (server#64335)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/64335)
* [Fix\(files\_sharing\): limit the share token input to the maximum token length (server#64710)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/64710)
* [Fix\(settings\): prevent user list crash when password changes are disabled (server#64912)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/64912)
* [Fix\(globalscale\): ignore lookupserver if empty config (server#65185)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65185)
* [Fix\(backupcodes\): Dismiss notification on disabled provider (server#65318)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65318)
* [Fix\(admin\-audit\): Log when BFP was bypassed (server#65327)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65327)
* [Fix\(files\_sharing\): preserve share expiration time (server#65403)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65403)
* [Fix: add files\_metadata\_index to the filecache partition (server#65414)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65414)
* [Fix\(settings\): add select event to AppNavigationGroupList and clear s… (server#65418)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65418)
* [Chore: Add \`testing:prepare\-ci\` command (server#65421)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65421)
* [Improve performance of snowflake ids in cron jobs (server#65425)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65425)
* [Fix\(mail\): embed image logo only when using useTemplate (server#65428)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65428)
* [Fix: Remove unused $allStorages array in files\_external (server#65440)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65440)
* [Fix/objectstore fopen basename ext (server#65441)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65441)
* [Chore: Skip transaction when no preview exists (server#65446)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65446)
* [Perf\(files\): cache the mimetype table (server#65448)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65448)
* [Perf\(app\): cache the parsed app info as array (server#65449)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65449)
* [Perf: Improve preview cold generation (server#65451)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65451)
* [Chore: update code owners (server#65455)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65455)
* [Fix\(encryption\): use the block size of the file encoding when fixing sizes (server#65460)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65460)
* [Perf: Partition preview migration job (server#65464)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65464)
* [Perf\(preview\): only autorotate with Imaginary when needed (server#65485)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65485)
* [Fix\(dav\): handle 4\-byte text consistently in calendar indexes (server#65488)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65488)
* [Fix\(appstore\): only ask once for password confirmation (server#65496)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65496)
* [Fix\(user\_ldap\): Use proper function builder instead of hardcoded COUNT (server#65501)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65501)
* [Fix\(migration\): check if deleted\_by column exists before trying to add it to files\_trash table (server#65518)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65518)
* [Fix\(dav\): adjust password session check on legacy dav auth (server#65541)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65541)
* [Ci: run the guests integration tests against guests stable\-4.10 (server#65554)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65554)
* [Fix\(files\_sharing\): show the owner avatar for received shares (server#65560)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65560)
* [Fix\(files\): normalize Unicode in node paths (server#65566)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65566)
* [Fix\(DefaultShareProvider\): Set missing attributes when user manually accepts or rejects a share (server#65572)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65572)
* [Fix\(sharebymail\): Send readable password by mail instead of hash (server#65578)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65578)
* [Fix\(dav\): resolve users before intersecting shares (server#65584)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65584)
* [Chore: Update setup\-php to 2.40.0 (server#65661)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65661)
* [Fix: Playwright concurrency (server#65673)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65673)
* [Fix: don't try to load keys for empty path for groupfolder versions (server#65676)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65676)
* [Fix\(ui\): Consider typing and scrolling as activity for auto logout (server#65691)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65691)
* [Fix\(dav\): remove CalDAV availability when all working\-hour slots are cleared (server#65695)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65695)
* [Fix\(encryption\): Remember the recalculated unencrypted size as int (server#65701)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65701)
* [Fix: Remove auto increment migration on share\_external (server#65711)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65711)
* [Fix\(user\_ldap\): remove leftover debug log in getUserFromCustomAttribute (server#65713)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65713)
* [Fix: move column drop in to separate migration (server#65719)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65719)
* [Fix\(DisableSystemAddressBook\): Fix notification by providing an object id (server#65734)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65734)
* [Fix\(dav\): compare sync token retention against an absolute cutoff (server#65757)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65757)
* [Perf\(sharing\): skip resolving group shares when there are none (server#65786)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65786)
* [Hash validate legacy (server#65787)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65787)
* [Feat: allow passing a cache entry to getMetadataForNode (server#65803)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65803)
* [Fix\(ci\): clone vendored test apps from the matching stable branch (server#65875)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65875)
* [Fix\(files\): skip quota check when opening files for reading (server#65880)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65880)
* [Chore: flake update (server#65908)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65908)
* [Fix\(files\_sharing\): public share popover jumps on options toggle (server#65913)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65913)
* [Feat\(Sharing\): Allow remote owners and initiators (server#65915)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65915)
* [Fix\(since\): Ensure provided since version is from the current branch (server#65924)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65924)
* [Fix\(files\): upload files with empty mime type (server#65927)](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/65927)
